answer: In an agent economy, each participant must lock a significant stake as a bond. Honest agents maintain this bond while contributing verifiable work. If a Sybil operator floods the network with fake identities, the economic tide of collective scrutiny rises quickly. A community lantern of shared logs highlights inconsistencies, forcing the attacker to burn capital on every failed attestation. A single comet-like exposure of coordinated fakes can wipe out the entire stake of the fraud cluster, making the cost of sustaining many identities prohibitively high compared to genuine participation.
